name: StockFi
description: Read-only x402 APIs for Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens, paid per call in USDG on chain 4663. Preflight returns GO, CAUTION or STOP before a swap; Reopen Risk projects a Longbow loan's health factor at Monday's reopen. $0.02 to $0.10 per call. Data only: never holds funds, signs or trades. Not investment advice. Payee name: stockfi.hoodfi.eth.

services.name: preflight
services.description: GET ?symbol= or ?token=, x402 exact scheme: $0.02 USDG on Robinhood Chain (eip155:4663). Add sizeUsdg (or use /v1/preflight/quote) for a Uniswap v3 route quote at $0.05.

services.name: reopen-risk
services.description: GET ?wallet=0x…, x402 exact scheme: $0.03 USDG snapshot; /v1/reopen-risk/weekend is the $0.10 full weekend report.
